title: FS-RC-Actuarial-Investments Agenda-Senior
jobDescription:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. Senior, Life Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team! The opportunity We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals. Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities. Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients. Your key responsibilities As a Senior Consultant, you will:
- Responsible for delivering high quality results and generating effective and impactful solutions
- Provide focused solutions and training to Staff members
- Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
- Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality, consistently driving projects to completion and ensuring that work is of high standard We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network. Skills and attributes for success
- Good analytical skills
- Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems.
- Hands-on experience in actuarial valuation software Prophet will be added advantage. Advanced level experience in Prophet will be valuable
- Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
- In-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of US / EMEIA / APAC markets
- Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work
- Self-motivation and proactiveness in driving project
- Willingness to travel to meet and work with clients To qualify for the role, you must have
- Experienced resource – preferably 3-6 years
- Experienced in the following topics: Actuarial reserving, Assumption setting, Modelling software Ideally, you’ll also have
- Experience of working with Prophet, MG ALFA, GGY Axis, Moses, RAFM, etc.
- Knowledge of IFRS 17, US GAAP, Solvency II and other insurance regulations around the globe
- Preferred Actuarial Degree / Good exam progress
- Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree ideally business, actuarial or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification What we look for
- Good communication skills
- English fluent in speaking

title: Oracle Tech Architecture And Middleware-MuleSoft Integration Architect-Manager
jobDescription:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. Mule Soft
- Manager: At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.​ Join EY and help to build a better working world. About Global Delivery Services Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda. Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom. Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service. Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services. Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation. The Opportunity At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, supported by our global scale, inclusive culture, and advanced technology. We value your unique voice and perspective to help EY continuously improve. Join us to create an exceptional experience for yourself and contribute to building a better working world for all. Your Key Responsibilities
- Lead and manage Mule Soft service delivery projects, ensuring successful design, development, and implementation.
- Design integration solutions based on source and destination system requirements using Mule Soft Anypoint Platform.
- Oversee API design and development, applying API-led connectivity methodology.
- Implement multiple connectors and integration patterns, handling various message formats.
- Manage code version control using tools such as Jenkins, Git Hub, and Azure Dev Ops.
- Lead proposal activities including estimation and staffing.
- Mentor, guide, and manage project teams and collaborate directly with customer teams.
- Apply expertise in Mule Soft Anypoint Studio, Runtime Manager, RAML, YAML, batch jobs, data transformations using Data Weave, flow controls, error handling, and security implementation (OAuth).
- Ensure adherence to best practices and deployment models.
- Stay updated on emerging technologies including Generative AI, AI agents, and Mule Soft’s latest AI advancements.
- Utilize knowledge of other middleware platforms to enhance integration solutions. Skills and attributes for success Ideally, you’ll also
- Have experience designing and working on at least three middleware engagements using different technologies.
- Be well-versed in web service fundamentals (HTTP/HTTPS) and have strong knowledge in SOAP and REST service design and implementation.
- Possess expertise in XML and related technologies such as XSLT, XSD, WSDL, XPath, and JSON message formats.
- Demonstrate strong understanding of integration patterns including file, batch, real-time, and JMS messaging. What we look for
- Minimum 8+ years of experience in service delivery projects with at least 5 years of hands-on Mule Soft design and development experience.
- Deep knowledge of Mule Soft architecture, error handling, and data reprocessing mechanisms.
- Proven ability to manage proposals, including estimation and staffing.
- Strong leadership skills with experience managing and mentoring teams.
- Mandatory possession of one or more Architect Level Mule Soft certifications.
- Ability to work effectively in dynamic environments and deliver high-quality integration solutions.
- Possession of one or more Architect Level certifications is mandatory, including:
- Mule Soft Certified Integration Architect
- Level 1 (required)
- Mule Soft Certified Platform Architect
- Level 1 (preferred)
- Mule Soft Certified Catalyst Specialist (preferred)
- Holding one or more developer certifications is highly desirable, such as:
- Mule Soft Certified Developer
- Level 1 (required)
- Mule Soft Certified Developer
- Level 2 (preferred) What we offer you At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need. Our Commitment : As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost. Professional Development : From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship. People and Culture : In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing. Benefits : Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development. How to Apply : If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy. Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits. “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”. EY | Building a better working world EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets. Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow. EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

- a m?ultidisciplinary competency, gathering capabilities in transformation architecture, experience design, business design and transformation execution to problem-solve, design and deliver large scale, multi-year, multi-stakeholder transformation programs. Supply Chain and Operations
- we provide a unique combination of industry-specific, strategic, operational and financial insights, digital technology advances and strategic alliance partners to deliver better outcomes and also help clients effect fundamental change in their operations’ performance to support sales growth, become more cost competitive, minimize risk and ensure operational resilience. - Managing communication

- Managing office of the Partner (Practice Leader)
- Managing communication

- collecting, processing and submitting claims in a timely and accurately
- Managing meetings, calendars, organizing meetings and presentations for the office of Partner / practice team Skills and attributes To qualify for the role you must have Qualification
- Bachelor of Commerce

jobDescription:
Requisition Id: 1724628 As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self. The opportunity : Director-National-PAS WKFA-CNS
- PC
- TALENT
- Hyderabad National : National comprises of sector agnostic teams working across industries for a well rounded experience. CNS
- PC
- TALENT : At EY, People Consulting professionals help clients' in strategically aligning their people agenda with broader business goals. By placing Humans@Center of the transformation journey, we help organizations drive sustainable change through the power of their workforce. Our approach enables clients to reimagine their future workforce—ensuring they have the right talent, with the right skills, in the right roles, at the right cost—ultimately turning their people strategy into a competitive advantage. The key fields of play are: Organization and Workforce Transformation- Integrated approach to align business and workforce strategies with current and future operating models by applying capabilities such as scenario modelling, org design, workforce planning & analytics as well as talent strategy, leveraging our proprietary, award-winning EY Organization & Talent Hub. Change Experience & Learning
- Working with clients to define the new Workforce Experience including New Ways of Working (Agile, Design Thinking, Digital, Problem Solving, Collaboration) as well as accelerated adoption through our digitally-enabled Change Experience tracked via Change Insights and Digital Learning via our EY Noggin Labs platform. Purpose, Culture and Leadership
- Align leadership and cultural programs with clients’ business strategy, purpose and operating model, adapting to the changing needs of their customers and building modern leadership and talent capabilities to drive efficiency and innovation. HR Transformation, Systems and Rewards
- Re-imagining and digitizing the HR function, including HR strategy, HR service delivery model, HR cloud technology as well as transforming employee policies and rewards to align with business and individual objectives. Your key responsibilities Technical Excellence
- The Director will lead the Technical Excellence agenda within People Consulting, driving large-scale HR transformation programmes, HR technology implementations, delivery governance, capability building, solution development, and strategic client relationships. The role requires a balance of consulting leadership, programme delivery excellence, commercial acumen, and practice-building capabilities. Client Leadership Lead large, complex People Consulting engagements across multiple clients and geographies. Serve as a trusted advisor to CHROs, HR leaders, GCC leaders, and business executives. Drive executive stakeholder management and governance forums. Delivery Excellence Own programme delivery quality, profitability, risk management, and client satisfaction. Establish delivery methodologies, quality standards, playbooks, and governance frameworks. Lead large transformation programmes including HR technology, digital HR, operating model, and workforce transformation initiatives. Technical Excellence Define and institutionalise best practices across the People Consulting practice. Build reusable assets, accelerators, tools, templates, and methodologies. Drive innovation leveraging AI, digital HR, workforce analytics, automation, and emerging HR technologies. Practice Development Develop capability roadmaps and mentor managers, senior managers, and project teams. Support knowledge management and competency building initiatives. Contribute to thought leadership, market positioning, and eminence programmes. Business Development Lead pursuit teams and solutioning for strategic opportunities. Support proposal development, client presentations, and commercial negotiations. Build and expand relationships within existing accounts to drive consulting revenue growth. Skills and attributes To qualify for the role you must have Qualification
- Master of Technology in Civil Engineering
- Master of Engineering in Electronics
- Master of Science in Data Science
- Master of Arts in Psychology
- Master of Commerce
- Master of Business Administration
- Master of Computer Applications
- Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science
- Bachelor of Engineering in Electrical
- Bachelor of Science in Physics
- Bachelor of Science in Chemistry
- Bachelor of Commerce
- Bachelor of Computer Applications
- Post Graduate Diploma in Management Experience
- Business Intelligence (3+ years)
- Financial Analysis (3+ years)
- Customer Success Management (3+ years)
- Talent Acquisition (3+ years)
- HR Operations (4+ years)
- Project Management (6+ years) What we look for People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach. What we offer Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible. Join us in shaping the future with confidence. jobDescription:
Technology Consulting Title: Manager II, Product Manager EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization. Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact. EY Technology: Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization. EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units: Client Technology (CT)
- focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly. Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience. Information Security (Info Sec)
- Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems. The opportunity This role leads a team responsible for the strategic vision and roadmap for a digital product or products, often with cross-divisional impact, demonstrating a deep comprehensive understanding of the digital product(s) and associated business areas. This role also applies market insights and customer trends to drive product innovation and life cycle enhancements. Your key responsibilities Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.Oversees digital product management activities for multiple digital products, or one strategic digital product.Influences and collaborates with cross-functional teams to create best practices that drive significant change to the client experience.Provides guidance and coaches digital product teams towards best practices and learnings. Manages product teams' support of the messaging, communication, and client outreach as necessary.Facilitates strong business support through working with team members to promote a consistent approach to decisions/impacts and client propositions.Leads the planning, development, and implementation of new products with significant impact. Defines and analyzes markets, developing detailed product features and requirements, and developing implementation plans.Influences and employs a variety of qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to continually improve the user experience.Participates in and influences ongoing business planning and departmental prioritization activities.Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.Manages the full product life cycle from planning to execution, ensuring alignment with broader organizational strategy and goals.Conducts market research and analyzes consumer trends to identify opportunities for product innovation or enhancement.Collaborates across functions to define product features and oversees their development.Prepares and maintains product documentation and equips sales and marketing teams with relevant technical knowledge.Utilizes market feedback to evaluate product performance and inform future product direction. Skills and attributes for success A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders To qualify for the role, you must have Minimum 8 years of experience in product management, digital strategy, or related fields, with at least 3 years leading cross-functional initiatives.Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech/BBA) in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Graduate degree (MBA/MS) preferred.Good to have skills in product lifecycle management, product innovation, market analysis, cross-functional team leadership, and user experience improvement.Strong proficiency in collaboration tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence), and understanding of digital product ecosystems, roadmapping, and go-to-market strategies.Excellent problem-solving, communication (verbal & written), and stakeholder management skills.Preferred certifications include Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Pragmatic Marketing Certification, or SAFe Product Manager/Product Owner.Ability to adapt to dynamic business needs, synthesize insights from multiple sources, and deliver data-backed product decisions. Ideally, you’ll also have Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client) What we look for Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values. What working at EY offers We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with Flex EY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer: Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance. About EY As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we’re using the finance products, expertise and systems we’ve developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible. - Work with business operations team to oversee the development of proposals and direct the account coordinators on their assigned accounts.

- Manage and collaborate with the internal partners and the business heads to ensure high level of customer satisfaction.
- Build strong global and cross border relationships. Identify opportunities and encourage sector teams to understand and achieve business goals.

- MBA or PGDM from premium institute (Preferred) Experience
- 12+ years of BD/sales experience, selling consulting services. - Proficient in using SQL to extract, transform, and analyze large investigative datasets efficiently. - Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science Experience
- Data Engineering (4+ years)

Requisition Id: 1725650 As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self. The opportunity : Assistant Manager-Operations-HR-CBS
- TAL
- Talent Consulting
- Hyderabad Operations : No Data Available CBS
- TAL
- Talent Consulting : At Talent team, we empower you to have a sense of purpose and opportunities that add value to your overall career experience at EY. The team works together across functions and service lines to build strategic solutions that support our strategy and employer value proposition (EVP). The team partners effectively with the business leaders, providing strategic talent advice to work in an integrated manner, leveraging solutions and best practices. The teams are responsible for enabling the business, driving the engagement of our people locally and bringing our strategy and EVP to life. The team includes workstreams like, Business Partnering, Talent Acquisition, Learning and Development, Mobility, Compensation and benefit and enabling functions like HR systems, Operations, People Data Reporting and Analytics. They also leverage our global strength and scalability to drive HR-related technology, projects and processes that allow EY to deliver against the changing requirements to enable success. The core focus of the team is to ensure an exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. Your key responsibilities Technical Excellence
- The opportunity The Assistant Manager is a key role within the Talent Team, acting as a bridge between HR and business leaders to ensure the alignment of HR initiatives with business objectives. This role requires a proactive individual who can analyze HR metrics, support employee engagement, facilitate talent management, and contribute to HR process automation and initiatives. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing HR processes with minimal oversight, maintaining high-quality standards, and ensuring compliance with employment laws and regulations. Your key responsibilities Stakeholder Partnership:
- Analyze HR metrics to identify trends and areas for improvement, and report findings to business leaders.
- Assist employees in adapting to organizational changes and transitions. Employee Advocacy & Engagement:
- Generate insights and develop actionable plans to enhance employee engagement and satisfaction.
- Guide supervisors on team management, conflict resolution, and effective communication.
- Share best practices from across the organization with counsellors.
- Advocate for employee well-being and conduct Focus Group Discussions (FGDs) as per the ECHO Framework. Talent Management:
- Facilitate the performance management process, including setting performance standards and guiding managers on providing constructive feedback.
- Assist counsellors in addressing issues of underperformance and support the integration of new joiners. Operational Effectiveness and Regulatory Adherence
- Oversee HR procedures for a sizable employee group of 400-600, ensuring seamless operations with limited supervision.
- Uphold superior standards in the execution of HR functions.
- Address and settle employee concerns autonomously.
- Comprehend and consistently apply employment legislation and regulatory requirements. Initiatives:
- Contribute to the automation of simple HR processes to increase departmental efficiency.
- Participate in local events or Service Line/Sub-Service Line wide initiatives.
- Create and maintain a collaboration platform for counsellors. Skills and attributes for success
- Proven experience in HR, preferably in a business partnering role.
- Strong understanding of HR metrics and their impact on business outcomes.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex and dynamic environment.
- Knowledge of employment laws and regulations.
- Experience in managing HR processes and resolving employee grievances. Skills and attributes To qualify for the role you must have Qualification
- "•\t Masters degree from Premium Institute (Preferred)" Experience
- •\t5+ years of HR Business Partnering experience. The opportunity : Consultant-TMT-TAX-TAX
- ITTS
- Transfer Pricing
- Hyderabad TMT : Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media & Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now. We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of M&A strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future – building a better working world for all. TAX
- ITTS
- Transfer Pricing : Our globally coordinated tax professionals offer connected services across all tax disciplines to help the clients thrive in an era of rapid change. We combine our exceptional knowledge and experience with the people and technology platforms to equip clients in making better business decisions by bringing insights to the forefront. We help companies understand the tax policies and tax laws of governments around the world to plan and comply accordingly. Our teams leverage transformative technologies to deliver strategy and execution, from tax and regulatory obligations to operations and workforce management, to reduce risk and drive sustainable value. We have competencies in Business Tax Services, Global Compliance and Reporting, Global Law, Indirect Tax, International Tax and Transaction Services. Your key responsibilities Technical Excellence
- Consultant – Tax – Transfer Pricing LI The opportunity EY is looking for Consultant in the Transfer Pricing Tax team with the main objective to help the core Tax teams deliver quality deliverables / solutions using general tax knowledge gained from training or education and assistance from more experienced tax professionals and contribute to the profitable growth by ensuring client engagements are executed in an efficient manner. Your key responsibilities
- Preparing transfer pricing documentation reports
- Develop specialized competence and begin to attract recognition within own service line as a technical resource for that specialization.
- Identification of international transactions, computation of arm’s length price, selection of the most appropriate method, documentation and preparation of transfer pricing study reports.
- Complete Transfer Pricing assignments which include benchmarking studies for various multinational clients.
- Managing a team of Consultants and Interns who would be working on specific clients related to the industry.
- Assisting clients in transfer pricing/supply chain planning
- Expands opportunities with existing clients, identifies and acts on referrals in relation to the Service Line
- Conducting economic analysis/ comparability analysis. Should be well versed in using Indian and foreign databases
- Preparing technical submissions for assessments & appellate level
- Representing the client's case before the Tax Officer/ Appellate level
- Should be well versed with technical concepts of evolving Transfer Pricing law in India Skills and attributes for success
- Should be well versed with OECD TP Guidelines and transfer pricing regulations of developed countries
- Should be proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PPT) To qualify for the role you must have
- A qualified Chartered Accountant
- 1-2 years of core transfer pricing experience Ideally you’ll also have
- Strong communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
- Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
- Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)
- Strong leadership skills and supervisory responsibility. What we look for People with the ability to work in a collaborative way to provide services across multiple client departments while adhering to commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. - Bachelor of Commerce

- Bachelor of Arts in English Literature Experience
- Project Management (6+ years) What we look for People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. - Investigations & Compliance : Successful organizations depend on their reputation for keeping promises, respecting laws and behaving ethically to maintain stakeholder trust. EY Forensic & Integrity Services professionals help organizations protect and restore enterprise and financial reputation. We assist companies and their legal counsel to investigate facts, resolve disputes and manage regulatory challenges. We put integrity at the heart of compliance programs to help better manage ethical and reputational risks. Our integrated approach ranges from enhancements in areas of perceived weakness or issues — including governance, controls, culture and data insights — to full organizational design and structural implementation. - Experience: 3-5 years Skills: Data Privacy and Protection Preferred Certifications: CIPP, CIPM, CIPT, AIGP, ISO About the Role EY is looking for professionals with 3-5 years of proven privacy experience. The ideal candidate is a privacy professional with strong understanding of global regulations, practical implementation experience, and the ability to work with business, legal, technology, and risk teams. The candidate should be comfortable supporting client-facing engagements, preparing high-quality deliverables, and translating privacy requirements into actionable business processes and controls. Key Responsibilities Support the design and implementation of enterprise-wide privacy programs aligned with applicable privacy laws globally and industry leading practices. Assist in developing privacy policies, SOPs, guidelines, and operating models. Support privacy maturity assessments and gap assessments against regulatory and organizational requirements. Work with stakeholders to operationalize privacy controls across business units and functions. Conduct and maintain data mapping, TIA, DPIA, Ro PA, privacy notices, and retention schedules. Support DSR, consent, and breach management. Work with business and technology teams to embed privacy-by-design and privacy-by-default principles. Support privacy reviews of vendors, processors, partners, and third-party service providers, and update/draft agreements. Assist with other regulatory compliance engagements globally, outside privacy domain. Manage assigned workstreams, timelines, and stakeholder communications. Support proposal/business development, operations, and internal knowledge-building initiatives. Preferred Qualifications and Functional Skills LL.B. graduate from a recognised university. Candidates with recognised privacy certifications (like IAPP & ISO) will be preferred. Familiarity with privacy technology tools such as One Trust, Trust Arc, Securiti, or similar platforms will be preferred. Good understanding of information security concepts and their intersection with privacy. Strong documentation, report writing, and presentation skills. Ability to manage multiple deliverables in a consulting or fast-paced environment. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management capabilities. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in teams. Attention to detail and ability to produce high-quality deliverables. Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information responsibly. Candidates from Noida should be willing to travel to Gurgaon for client requirements. Candidates should be open to working in flexible shifts to support international client requirements across different time zones. title: Oil & Gas -Leader
jobDescription:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. JOB DESCRIPTION Position Summary (Enter the description)
-
- Oil & Gas Sector Leader responsible for driving sector-led growth through origination, deal shaping, and execution of large-scale transformation programs, with a strong emphasis on strengthening sales enablement, pipeline quality, and strategic account penetration across the Oil & Gas portfolio.
- Acts as a senior industry advisor, translating industry disruption, energy transition priorities, operational transformation opportunities, digital enablement, and sustainability imperatives into actionable client opportunities while building a differentiated sector proposition and positioning EY as a partner of choice for complex, high-value transformation engagements. Objective and purpose:
- Drive origination and closure of large, complex transformation opportunities, translating sector priorities such as energy transition, operational excellence, digital modernization, asset optimization, and sustainability into actionable, high-value deals.
- Act as a trusted advisor to Oil & Gas C-suite leaders, shaping enterprise transformation agendas across upstream, midstream, downstream, trading, and supporting functions with a clear link to business outcomes and value realization.
- Build and commercialize differentiated sector offerings, thought leadership, and alliance-enabled solutions while strengthening EY's market position and establishing GDS as a strategic partner for enterprise-scale transformation across the Oil & Gas value chain. Scope of the position:
- Drive the GDS Oil & Gas sector agenda across priority accounts, aligning global client needs with GDS capabilities to identify, shape, and scale high-value transformation opportunities across the upstream, midstream, downstream, and energy trading value chain.
- Lead end-to-end pursuit lifecycle, including opportunity qualification, solution shaping, commercial structuring, and deal closure, ensuring strong integration with global account teams and regional industry leadership.
- Drive sales enablement at scale through disciplined pipeline management, pursuit governance, sector narratives, and reusable playbooks that improve win rates and accelerate revenue growth.
- Lead integrated go-to-market initiatives across Consulting, Technology, Tax, Assurance, Strategy & Transactions, and Alliances to deliver differentiated, market-facing Oil & Gas solutions.
- Build and maintain executive relationships with Oil & Gas clients, engaging C-suite stakeholders to shape transformation agendas focused on operational excellence, asset productivity, cost optimization, sustainability, and enterprise modernization.
- Develop and commercialize sector-specific assets, benchmarks, and accelerators that enable faster deal shaping, repeatable delivery, and differentiated positioning in the marketplace.
- Guide clients in transforming hydrocarbon value chain operations through digital field operations, production optimization, integrated planning, supply chain modernization, and AI-enabled decision intelligence.
- Advise clients on energy transition and asset-intensive transformation priorities, including decarbonization strategies, asset lifecycle management, capital project optimization, and the application of digital technologies to improve production performance, reliability, and operational resilience. Essential Functions of the job (Enter the description)
- Institutionalize sector-led sales excellence by defining pursuit methodologies, qualification frameworks, commercial governance processes, and executive sponsorship models that improve consistency and effectiveness across strategic opportunities.
- Lead the development and commercialization of Oil & Gas sector intellectual property, including industry frameworks, benchmarks, solution accelerators, and differentiated assets that strengthen EY's market proposition.
- Establish and govern strategic alliances and ecosystem relationships, enabling the development of integrated solutions that enhance client value and expand EY's relevance across the Oil & Gas landscape.
- Sponsor capability building across GDS by developing sector talent, strengthening industry acumen, and fostering a high-performing team with deep Oil & Gas domain expertise.
- Guide the evolution of GDS delivery models for the sector, ensuring the effective integration of consulting, technology, data, and managed services capabilities to support large-scale transformation programs.
- Advise clients on operational and asset-intensive transformation priorities, including production optimization, asset lifecycle management, maintenance effectiveness, and digital operations initiatives that improve efficiency, reliability, and business performance.
- Provide thought leadership on industry disruption themes, including energy transition, decarbonization, carbon management, and emerging energy business models, helping clients navigate strategic choices while positioning EY as a trusted transformation partner. Analytical/Decision making Responsibilities (Enter the description)
- Assess emerging industry trends and disruption themes, including energy transition, commodity price volatility, regulatory developments, decarbonization priorities, and changing demand patterns, to inform sector strategy and long-term investment decisions.
- Determine the strategic focus of sector offerings and solutions, evaluating market opportunities, client demand signals, and competitive differentiation to guide the development and commercialization of new capabilities.
- Analyze complex transformation opportunities and client business cases, balancing expected business value, implementation feasibility, risk exposure, and resource requirements to recommend the most effective transformation pathways.
- Provide strategic direction on operational and asset-intensive improvement initiatives, evaluating trade-offs across production performance, asset reliability, capital efficiency, sustainability objectives, and long-term value creation to support executive decision making. Education and Experience (Enter the description)
- 25+ years of relevant experience in consulting (Big 4 / strategy consulting) and/or senior industry leadership roles within the Oil & Gas sector, with a demonstrated track record of driving growth, transformation, operational improvement, and business-led change initiatives.
- Proven experience advising and influencing C-suite stakeholders across global Oil & Gas organizations, including leading large-scale transformation programs, strategic pursuits, and complex business development opportunities.
- Demonstrated success in building and scaling sector practices, developing differentiated offerings, shaping go-to-market strategies, and driving revenue growth in matrixed, global organizations.
- Experience building and leveraging ecosystem-led solutions with technology partners such as Aspen Tech, AVEVA, SLB, Halliburton Landmark, Baker Hughes, Emerson, Honeywell, SAP, Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Databricks, translating technology capabilities into differentiated transformation propositions and measurable business outcomes for clients.
- Strong academic background, with an MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred; undergraduate degree in engineering, business, geosciences, energy management, technology, or a related discipline typically expected. Knowledge and Skill requirements (Enter the description)
- Deep understanding of the Oil & Gas value chain, including upstream, midstream, downstream, trading, and integrated energy business models, with the ability to connect operational priorities to enterprise transformation outcomes.
- Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to evaluate investment decisions, deal economics, value drivers, and business cases, and translate them into compelling, outcome-oriented client strategies.
- Advanced problem-solving and structured thinking capability, with the ability to synthesize complex operational, technology, regulatory, and market challenges into actionable strategic choices and transformation priorities.
- Executive-level communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage credibly with senior business and technology stakeholders, simplify complex industry issues, and drive alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.
- Knowledge of key Oil & Gas technology platforms and digital ecosystems, including solutions such as Aspen Tech, AVEVA, SLB Delfi, Halliburton Landmark, SAP, Microsoft Azure, AWS, Databricks, and industrial data platforms, with an understanding of how these technologies enable operational excellence, digital operations, and enterprise transformation. Good to have (Differentiators)
- Strong perspective on the future of the Oil & Gas industry, including emerging trends such as energy transition, carbon capture and storage (CCUS), hydrogen, biofuels, digital energy ecosystems, AI-enabled operations, and the evolving role of integrated energy companies.
- Experience helping clients translate industry disruption into scalable growth strategies, new business models, operating model innovation, and differentiated pathways for long-term value creation.
- Proven ability to operate effectively in global, matrixed organizations, collaborating across geographies, service lines, alliance partners, and delivery centers to shape and execute complex, multi-region transformation programs.
- Experience applying advanced analytics, digital twins, industrial AI, and intelligent operations capabilities to improve production efficiency, asset performance, maintenance effectiveness, supply chain resilience, and operational decision making.
- Established industry network and market presence through thought leadership, industry forums, ecosystem partnerships, and executive engagement across the upstream, midstream, downstream, and broader energy ecosystem. EY | Building a better working world EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: RC-REGULATORY COMPLIANCE-CSV-QA -Senior Manager
jobDescription:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. EY – GDS Consulting – Enterprise Risk (ER) – Regulatory Compliance – Senior Manager – CSV/QA Lead At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. As part of our EY-ER- Regulatory Compliance team, you will help the clients by understanding their business needs and delivering solutions in accordance with the EY guidelines & methodologies. As a Regulatory Compliance Senior Manager actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. In line with our commitment to quality, you’ll consistently drive projects to completion with high quality deliverables, achieve operational efficiency, proactively identify and raise risks with the client as well as EY senior management team and lead internal initiatives. The opportunity We are seeking a highly experienced and detail-oriented Senior Manager – Computerized System Validation (CSV) to lead and manage validation activities for Gx P-regulated computerized systems across global pharmaceutical clients. The ideal candidate will ensure compliance with global regulatory standards (FDA, EMA, MHRA) and drive strategic initiatives for business process transformation and operational excellence. This role involves leadership, client engagement, and mentoring teams, while maintaining validated systems throughout their lifecycle. Role Overview As a Senior Manager – Computer System Validation (CSV), you will lead the Gx P validation, implementation. Quality and compliance of IT systems within highly regulated Gx P environments, ensuring that all solutions meet stringent compliance, quality, and industry standards. Leveraging your deep expertise in Computer System Validation, Gx P regulations, and lifecycle documentation, you will guide clients through complex validation initiatives while ensuring alignment with business and regulatory expectations. Your primary responsibility will be to collaborate closely with clients to understand their operational and compliance needs, translating them into robust validation strategies and practical, risk-based solutions. You will oversee end-to-end validation activities—ranging from planning and requirements analysis to testing, documentation, and release—while ensuring systems are audit-ready and compliant with global regulatory requirements. Your key responsibilities
- Client Responsibilities
- Participate and lead Regulatory Compliance engagements.
- Help manage the financial aspects of engagements by organizing staffing, tracking fees, and communicating issues to project leaders.
- Drive-in business development initiatives along with client management and account management.
- Build strong internal relationships within Risk Consulting practice and with other services across the organization.
- Build connects with client stakeholders, understand their business challenges/pain areas and work with leadership to propose innovative solutions.
- People Responsibilities
- Develop people through effective coaching and mentoring.
- Conduct performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback.
- Contribute to people-related initiatives including recruiting, retaining, appraisal and training.
- Contribute towards building and strengthening team competency for Regulatory Compliance and Risk consulting.
- Participate in the organization-wide people initiatives.
- Maintain an educational program to develop skills of team members continually.
- Decision-Making

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Support management in workforce planning, resourcing strategy, go to market strategy and demand generation.
- Understand the business requirements clearly and lead practice development initiatives as required.
- Bring out of the box thinking mindset, and analytical thinking capability to enhance service delivery.
- Always maintain connections with clients to tap opportunities for constant growth and improvement.
- Understand the process gaps and propose preventive/corrective action where appropriate.
- Lead business growth, pursuits and client proposals for Enterprise Risk/Regulatory Compliance, directly working with the regional partners and senior managers. Other Responsibilities
- Actively contribute to the IT applications project management initiatives that include Validation/Qualification/Variance Management activities as per GAMP Life Cycle approach.
- Integrate technology with business process transformation programs like SAP, LIMS, ELN, MES, Documentum, Track Wise, Veeva Vault, Val Genesis, Argus, Regulatory Information Management System etc.
- Provide guidance and share knowledge and participate in performing procedures focusing on complex or specialized issues in a regulatory environment. Work with clients to create plans for accomplishing engagement objectives and a strategy that complies with professional standards and addresses the risks inherent in the engagement.
- Identify opportunities in existing accounts to cross-sell other EY services.
- Planning and monitoring of the project deliverables from the team.
- Create innovative insights for clients, adapt methods & practices to fit operational team needs & contribute to thought leadership documents.
- Demonstrate teamwork by working with cross functional teams across service lines in completing the deliverables within the timelines.
- Maintain a strong client focus by effectively serving client needs and developing productive working relationships with client personnel. Stay abreast of current business and economic developments and new pronouncements/standards relevant to the client's business.
- Regular status reporting to the Associate Directors, Partners, Directors and onsite coordinators.
- Actively contributes to improving operational efficiency on projects & internal initiatives.
- Demonstrate a detailed knowledge of market trends, competitor activities, EY products and service lines.
- Demonstrate flexibility to travel to the customer locations on need basis.
- Conduct performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff, seniors and managers.
- Foster teamwork, quality culture and lead by example.
- Understand and follow workplace policies and procedures.
- Training and mentoring project resources.
- Participate in the organization-wide initiatives.
- Lead practice initiatives and portfolios.
- Market trend +Digital trends.
- Cross skill and cross train the team members as per the business requirements. Skills and attributes for success
- Quality & Compliance managed services and Consulting experience in of Life Sciences Domain.
- Sound domain knowledge in pharmaceutical industry in the areas of Quality and Compliance
- Strong knowledge of Computerized Systems validation concepts such as GAMP 5
- A Risk-Based Approach to Compliant Gx P Computerized Systems.
- Strong knowledge of standards such as USFDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex
11.
- Strong knowledge of regulations such as USFDA, WHO, HIPAA, TGA, MCC, Anvisa etc.
- Versed with ICH guidelines, ISPE framework on Risk management, System Development Life Cycle concepts.
- Strong Knowledge on Enterprise IT applications like LIMS, SAP, ELN, MES, Documentum, Track Wise, Veeva Vault, Val Genesis, Argus, Regulatory Information Management System etc. in pharmaceutical organization.
- Strong knowledge of Quality System Elements such as Deviation, CAPA, and Change Controls etc. as they relate to Computer Systems.
- Strong understanding of Data Integrity requirements.
- Governance and reporting.
- Knowledge of Incident Management, Change Management, Periodic Review, Vendor Management, Quality Management Review procedures.
- Strong Knowledge on authoring and reviewing Validation Deliverables such as Validation Plan & report, Requirement specifications, Risk Analysis, Qualification Protocols & reports, Test Scripts, Traceability Matrix etc.
- Has supported Audits / Inspections. To qualify for the role, you must have
- MBA/B.E/B.Tech (Electronics, Electronics & Telecommunications, Comp. Science)/Postgraduate in Science (Preferably in Chemistry/Biochemistry) with 13-16 years of experience with Big 4 or Multi-National Regulatory Compliance/Life Sciences outsourcing companies.
- Good interpersonal skills; Good written and presentational skills.
- At managerial positions within Information Technology (IT) and/or Quality Assurance (QA) for major organizations.
- Experience in managing team and solution designing. Ideally, you’ll also have
- Certified Software Quality Engineer (CSQE), Certified Software Quality Assurance (CSQA)
- ISO 9001:2015 Lead Auditor, Quality Auditor Certification (CQA)
- Information Security or Risk Management certifications
- Project Management Professional (PMP) What working at EY offers At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
- Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
- Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
- The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you EY | Building a better working world EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

jobDescription:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. Job Summary: As a Xamarin/MAUI Architect, you will be responsible for defining and overseeing the architecture of mobile applications built with Xamarin.Forms and .NET MAUI. You will guide development teams, ensure best practices, and align technical solutions with business goals to deliver robust, scalable, and maintainable mobile applications. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Full stack developer who can function as a solution architect when needed.
- Senior Full stack role who should be comfortable working end-to-end on their own and coordinate with onshore lead.
- Skills: Proficiency in Xamarin.Forms/.NET MAUI for mobile app development, C#, Azure cloud services (API Management, Logic Apps, Function Apps, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL), backend API development, and integration with enterprise systems like SAP(must) and Ramsys (ideal).
-

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead design and development across mobile and cloud integration layers, coordinate with Dev Ops and QA, troubleshoot complex issues spanning frontend and backend.
- Experience: min 5 yr fullstack development experience, with significant exposure in leading mobile and cloud integration projects
- Define and establish the architecture and technical standards for Xamarin and .NET MAUI mobile applications.
- Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and high-performance mobile solutions.
- Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, and development teams to translate business requirements into technical designs.
- Provide technical leadership and mentorship to development teams.
- Evaluate and recommend tools, technologies, and processes to improve development efficiency and product quality.
- Ensure adherence to coding standards, security guidelines, and best practices.
- Oversee integration with backend services, APIs, and third-party systems.
- Conduct architectural reviews, code reviews, and performance tuning.
- Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends to drive innovation.
- Support project planning, risk management, and resource allocation.
- Experience with microservices architecture and API design.
- Knowledge of security best practices for mobile applications.
- Experience with Agile methodologies and tools.
- Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies.

QUALIFICATIONS:
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
- 8+ years of experience in mobile application development with at least 4 years focused on Xamarin.Forms and .NET MAUI.
- Proven experience in architecting complex cross-platform mobile applications.
- Deep expertise in C#, .NET, Xamarin.Forms, and .NET MAUI frameworks.
- Strong understanding of mobile app lifecycle, deployment, and performance optimization.
- Experience with MVVM, dependency injection, and other design patterns.
- Knowledge of native i OS and Android development principles.
- Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) and backend integration.
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and Dev Ops practices.
- Excellent problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. WAM Fund Accounting Business Analyst – Manager Requirements: As a Business Analyst you will be responsible for managing and delivering innovative solutions to the clients. Therefore, you must be flexible, adaptable and passionate about innovation. You will be responsible for liaising and managing key stakeholders and technical teams to ensure that the solutions are delivered successfully. The successful candidate will have:
- Experience working in Wealth or Asset management Industry in the areas of portfolio accounting / fund accounting
- Work experience in fund accounting platform migrations/implementations would be a big plus
- Leading teams/programs on key aspects of client’s fund accounting platform and business with experience in capital markets
- Strong knowledge on various asset classes such as fixed income, equity, derivatives across front office, middle office and back office for either or both “buy” and “sell” side of business
- Exposure to portfolio management, trade execution, data control and operations and portfolio administration
- Should Posses high-level understanding of data model and application/business architecture around the package
- Good experience understanding client requirements and streamline them appropriately to the team.
- Understand high-level business requirements and relate them to appropriate package capabilities
- Review client processes and workflows and make recommendations to the client to maximise benefits from package.
- Good Leadership skills
- Excellent client-facing skills
- MBA/CA/CFA/MCA/ BE / B.Tech/ equivalent with 10 to 15 years experience Preferred skills:
- Good Techno functional knowledge of Core Wealth / Asset management with good exposure to Geneva /FIS Hedge Fund Portfolio Manager/Temenos Multifonds, Simcorp etc
- Exposure to Charles River, Aladdin, Bloomberg AIM or other front office platforms
- Technical experience of working on data, understand relational data models, SQL queries
- Experience in any or more of Oracle, MS SQL, DB2 databases. Good data analytics skills
- Advanced excel and VBA skills EY | Building a better working world EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today. - Discovery : Successful organizations depend on their reputation for keeping promises, respecting laws and behaving ethically to maintain stakeholder trust. EY Forensic & Integrity Services professionals help organizations protect and restore enterprise and financial reputation. We assist companies and their legal counsel to investigate facts, resolve disputes and manage regulatory challenges. We put integrity at the heart of compliance programs to help better manage ethical and reputational risks. Our integrated approach ranges from enhancements in areas of perceived weakness or issues — including governance, controls, culture and data insights — to full organizational design and structural implementation. We want to help companies safeguard and restore financial and brand reputations. The insights and quality services we deliver help build trust and confidence in the capital markets and in economies the world over. Your key responsibilities Technical Excellence
- SQL/POWER BI Skills and attributes To qualify for the role you must have Qualification
- Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science Experience
- Frontend Development (2+ years)
- Backend Development (3+ years)
- Dev Ops Engineering (3+ years) What we look for People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach. What we offer Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities. EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing. If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible. Join us in shaping the future with confidence. title: DE-Digital Architecture-Digital Engineering TMT Leader-GDS
jobDescription:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. Job Description Job Name
- GDS Digital Engineering TMT Leader Position Summary The establishment of a GDS Digital Engineering Leader for TMT is critical to accelerate EY GDS Consulting’s growth in a sector experiencing rapid, technology-led disruption and innovation. TMT clients, including telecommunications service providers, digital media companies, streaming platforms, software and hardware technology firms, and emerging tech innovators are significantly increasing investments in platform and product engineering, cloud-native modernization, AI-enabled software development lifecycle (SDLC) transformation, digital content and data platforms, OSS/BSS modernization, 5G/6G networks and edge computing, and cyberresilient engineering. While demand is robust, GDS participation today tends to be capabilityspecific and opportunity-driven, which limits the ability to present a cohesive, end-to-end Digital Engineering value proposition tailored to the unique challenges and fast-paced evolution of the TMT landscape. This role provides dedicated executive leadership to transition from fragmented delivery models to a solution-led, engineering-centric approach, enhancing GDS integration, improving win-rates, and ensuring delivery predictability across TMT sub-sectors. Essential Functions of the job The scope of the position will include
- Build strong relationships with TMT sector leaders, account leaders, and EY Member Firms to influence account plans and drive growth. • Establish a solution and Field‑of‑Play‑based operating model for TMT Digital Engineering (product & platform engineering, cloud modernization, integration/API ecosystems, Dev Sec Ops, QA automation, SRE).
- Ensure GDS participation in large technology and transformation deals, supporting solution shaping, pricing, estimates, and RFP responses.
- Participate in and lead key client orals, demonstrating EY/GDS engineering capability, assets, and delivery excellence.
- Host CXO‑level client visits to GDS to showcase engineering studios, accelerators, innovation, and right‑shoring models.
- Build scalable right‑shoring delivery models, leveraging offshore and nearshore strengths while ensuring reliability and compliance.
- Establish delivery governance across pipeline, demand, delivery health, and cost of delivery.
- Build and mentor an engineering leadership bench (SM/EDs) aligned to priority TMT portfolios.
- Drive strategic collaboration with key technology partners, startups, and academic institutions within the TMT ecosystem to co-create cutting-edge engineering solutions and accelerate digital transformation across TMT sectors.
- Ensure all engineering solutions and delivery practices within EY GDS adhere to TMT industry-specific regulatory requirements, safety standards, and cybersecurity protocols, maintaining the highest standards of compliance and risk management. Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities
- Solve complex client problems by combining engineering, cloud,
- AI‑enabled SDLC, data platforms, and security
- Provide multiple solution options and guide TMT clients toward outcome‑driven engineering roadmaps
- Apply pragmatic, scalable engineering approaches to modernization, scale, and reliability challenges
- Use automation and standardization to improve delivery predictability and reduce cycle times Education & Experience
- Minimum 22-25 years of professional experience in technology consulting / digital engineering, including 8+ years in senior leadership roles, with deep exposure to TMT clients and transformation programs. Knowledge and Skills Requirements
- Demonstrated ability to lead complex initiatives involving platform and product engineering, cloud-native modernization, AI/ML-enabled software development lifecycle (SDLC) transformation, OSS/BSS modernization, 5G/edge computing deployments, digital content and data platform strategies, and cyber-resilient engineering within fast-evolving TMT environments. Desired experience: Leading large‑scale programs in platform/product engineering, cloud‑native modernization, Dev Sec Ops, CI/CD, integration/API platforms, QA automation, SRE Strong understanding of TMT operating models:
- Technology: platform scale, product‑led growth, engineering productivity o Media: content platforms, streaming architectures, data & personalization
- Telecom: OSS/BSS modernization, digital channels, network‑adjacent platforms
- Proven ability to sell and deliver large engagements using global delivery models
- Experience managing multi‑disciplinary, multi‑geo delivery teams EY | Building a better working world EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets. Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow. EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories. - Leading large-scale engineering programs: modernization, cloudnative engineering, platform/product engineering, integration, Dev Sec Ops, QA automation

- Audit
- Audit Services
- Mumbai CHS : CHS consists of Consumer Products and Healthcare sectors. Consumer products largely entail, Retail and Agri business. Companies in this sector meet the demands of consumers all around the world, every day; providing everything from agricultural crops to food, clothes, durables and retail experiences. Incumbents need to shift their focus from protecting what they have to creating what they need to become. The Health Sciences & Wellness architecture brings together a worldwide network of professionals to build data-centric approaches to customer engagement and improved outcomes. - Audit
- Audit Services : Assurance’s purpose is to inspire confidence and trust to enable a complex world to work. - CA stat audit background Skills and attributes To qualify for the role you must have Qualification
- CA Experience
