title: Consultant - Forensics - National - ASU - Forensics - Investigations & Compliance - Mumbai
jobDescription:
Requisition id: 1730562 The opportunity : Consultant-National-Forensics-ASU
- Forensics
- Investigations & Compliance
- Mumbai National : National comprises of sector agnostic teams working across industries for a well rounded experience. ASU
- Forensics
- Investigations & Compliance : Successful organizations depend on their reputation for keeping promises, respecting laws and behaving ethically to maintain stakeholder trust. EY Forensic & Integrity Services professionals help organizations protect and restore enterprise and financial reputation. We assist companies and their legal counsel to investigate facts, resolve disputes and manage regulatory challenges. We put integrity at the heart of compliance programs to help better manage ethical and reputational risks. Our integrated approach ranges from enhancements in areas of perceived weakness or issues — including governance, controls, culture and data insights — to full organizational design and structural implementation. We want to help companies safeguard and restore financial and brand reputations. The insights and quality services we deliver help build trust and confidence in the capital markets and in economies the world over. Your key responsibilities Technical Excellence
- Experience: 3-5 years Skills: Data Privacy and Protection Preferred Certifications: CIPP, CIPM, CIPT, AIGP, ISO About the Role EY is looking for professionals with 3-5 years of proven privacy experience. The ideal candidate is a privacy professional with strong understanding of global regulations, practical implementation experience, and the ability to work with business, legal, technology, and risk teams. The candidate should be comfortable supporting client-facing engagements, preparing high-quality deliverables, and translating privacy requirements into actionable business processes and controls. Key Responsibilities Support the design and implementation of enterprise-wide privacy programs aligned with applicable privacy laws globally and industry leading practices. Assist in developing privacy policies, SOPs, guidelines, and operating models. Support privacy maturity assessments and gap assessments against regulatory and organizational requirements. Work with stakeholders to operationalize privacy controls across business units and functions. Conduct and maintain data mapping, TIA, DPIA, Ro PA, privacy notices, and retention schedules. Support DSR, consent, and breach management. Work with business and technology teams to embed privacy-by-design and privacy-by-default principles. Support privacy reviews of vendors, processors, partners, and third-party service providers, and update/draft agreements. Assist with other regulatory compliance engagements globally, outside privacy domain. Manage assigned workstreams, timelines, and stakeholder communications. Support proposal/business development, operations, and internal knowledge-building initiatives. Preferred Qualifications and Functional Skills LL.B. graduate from a recognised university. Candidates with recognised privacy certifications (like IAPP & ISO) will be preferred. Familiarity with privacy technology tools such as One Trust, Trust Arc, Securiti, or similar platforms will be preferred. Good understanding of information security concepts and their intersection with privacy. Strong documentation, report writing, and presentation skills. Ability to manage multiple deliverables in a consulting or fast-paced environment. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management capabilities. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in teams. Attention to detail and ability to produce high-quality deliverables. Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information responsibly. Candidates from Noida should be willing to travel to Gurgaon for client requirements. Candidates should be open to working in flexible shifts to support international client requirements across different time zones. Skills and attributes To qualify for the role you must have Qualification
- BA LLB Experience
- Data Privacy and Protection (3-5 years) What we look for People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach. What we offer Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities. EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing. If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible. Join us in shaping the future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.​ Join EY and help to build a better working world. About Global Delivery Services Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda. Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom. Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service. Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services. Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation. About EY.ai Center for Reimagination This hiring is for the EY.ai Center for Reimagination, an AI-first innovation and engineering group focused on shaping next-generation enterprise experiences, digital humans, agentic AI platforms and reusable technology assets for client transformation. The Center brings together product thinking, software engineering, AI model integration, experience design, cloud-native architecture and responsible AI practices to rapidly prototype, industrialize and scale differentiated solutions across sectors. As part of this Center, the selected candidate will contribute to building secure, observable and production-ready AI-native platforms that combine Python-led backend services, agentic orchestration, LLM integrations, automation and enterprise-grade delivery practices. The role is intended for candidates who can help convert emerging AI concepts into scalable engineering patterns, reusable assets and client-ready solutions. The Opportunity We are looking for a Technical Architect / Manager for the EY.ai Center for Reimagination who can lead backend engineering for enterprise-grade digital, AI-native and agentic platforms, with strong depth in Python and working knowledge of Java and Go-based services. The role will define scalable architecture patterns across APIs, services, LLM integrations, agentic frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure AI Foundry / Foundry SDK, Open AI Agents SDK, Semantic Kernel, Auto Gen, Lang Chain / Lang Graph, Crew AI, Llama Index Workflows and MCP-enabled tool orchestration, along with automation and robotics-enabled solutions. The candidate will guide engineering teams and translate business requirements into secure, observable and maintainable backend and agentic AI solutions that can be reused across Center-led innovation, client transformation and AI platform delivery. The successful candidate will combine hands-on engineering credibility with architecture governance, delivery ownership and team leadership. This role requires the ability to make pragmatic design decisions, mentor engineers, review critical code paths and ensure that platform components are built for reliability, scale and long-term maintainability. Your Key Responsibilities
- Own backend and agentic platform architecture for Python-led platform components across APIs, services, automation utilities, AI/LLM integrations, multi-agent workflows, Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure AI Foundry, Open AI Agents SDK, Semantic Kernel, Auto Gen, Lang Chain / Lang Graph, Crew AI, Llama Index Workflows, MCP-based tool integration, robotics-enabled solutions and enterprise integration layers.
- Define design principles, reference patterns, coding standards and reusable engineering assets for backend teams.
- Translate functional and non-functional requirements into concrete architecture decisions covering scalability, security, performance, reliability and maintainability.
- Lead technical design reviews, code reviews, dependency assessments and production-readiness checks before major releases.
- Guide engineers on Python service design, Java service integration, API contracts, database access patterns, error management and automated testing.
- Partner with product owners, architects, Dev Ops teams and security stakeholders to align technology choices with business outcomes and delivery priorities.
- Drive CI/CD discipline, environment readiness, observability, logging, monitoring, vulnerability remediation and release governance.
- Identify delivery risks early, remove technical blockers, manage dependencies and ensure the team has the right tools, standards and support to execute effectively.
- Mentor senior developers, support capability building and create a culture of engineering excellence, documentation and reusable delivery practices.
- Contribute to estimation, sprint planning, backlog refinement, stakeholder communication and technical decision-making across delivery pods. Skills and attributes for success Must-have Python and engineering skills
- Strong hands-on Python & Java programming background for backend services, automation, scripting and enterprise integration.
- Proven experience designing REST APIs, microservices, event/message-based integrations and service-to-service communication patterns.
- Strong understanding of SQL/relational databases, data modelling, query optimisation, transaction handling and integration with application services.
- Experience with CI/CD, Git-based version control, automated testing, code quality gates, release management and Dev Ops practices.
- Ability to define architecture decisions, document trade-offs and govern implementation quality across multiple engineers.
- Security-first mindset covering secure coding, secrets handling, dependency hygiene, vulnerability remediation and compliance-aware delivery.
- Mandatory experience with AI engineering concepts, LLM-based solution design, prompt/orchestration patterns and safe integration of AI capabilities into enterprise applications.
- Hands-on knowledge of relevant AI agentic frameworks and platforms such as Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure AI Foundry / Foundry SDK, Open AI Agents SDK, Semantic Kernel, Auto Gen, Lang Chain / Lang Graph, Crew AI and Llama Index Workflows, including autonomous workflow design, tool/function calling, MCP-based tool integration, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop patterns, memory, planning and AI-enabled SDLC acceleration.
- Ability to evaluate and select the right agentic framework based on use case complexity, orchestration model, model/provider compatibility, tool ecosystem, MCP/A2A readiness, deployment model, governance, observability, enterprise security and production support requirements.
- Working understanding of model access patterns through Azure Open AI, Open AI APIs, Microsoft Foundry model endpoints and enterprise AI tooling, including embeddings, retrieval, file search, code interpreter, web search, memory, safety controls and evaluation workflows.
- Understanding of robotics, automation platforms, robotic process automation or robotics-integrated digital solutions, with the ability to connect software engineering patterns to physical or process automation use cases.
- Strong communication, stakeholder management, coaching and team leadership skills. Ideally, you’ll also have
- Experience with cloud-native architecture, containers, Kubernetes, serverless patterns, platform engineering or infrastructure automation.
- Exposure to AI-assisted engineering, agentic workflows, engineering productivity tooling or AI-enabled SDLC acceleration.
- Experience in regulated or security-sensitive domains such as banking, telecom, enterprise security or product engineering.
- Experience managing technical delivery across distributed teams, multiple workstreams or vendor/partner engineering groups. What We Look For
- We look for people who combine deep engineering craft with practical delivery ownership. The ideal candidate should be comfortable writing high-quality Python code, solving production-grade problems, collaborating with distributed teams and bringing a disciplined, security-aware mindset to client delivery.

- Knowledge of key important concept of insurance reporting (e.g., Reinsurance, Type of Reinsurance, Separate Accounts, General Account, Asset Valuation Reserve, Interest Maintenance Reserve and Protected Accounts) will be value added

title: GCR - UKI - Manager
jobDescription:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. Role name and description Manager – This role will manage internal teams, stakeholders and clients, in the view of ensuring the UK tax compliance deliverable are delivered on time and to a high standard of quality The opportunity When you join EY GCR team, you will be at the heart of EYs critical mission to build a better working world by applying knowledge skills and experience in assisting clients in meeting their business objectives. Your key responsibilities
- Apply your technical knowledge to our engagements / clients in ways that produce strategic outcomes to some very complex issues.
- Anchor a book of business by delivering a high quality work product efficiently, with managing risk.
- Developing clear, intelligent plans and approaches to improve our engagement economics. Drive margin outcome through effective utilisation of self and team.
- Provide meaningful business insights to client and onshore teams.
- Identifying potential opportunities for clients and potential additional opportunities that can be serviced from GDS.
- Learning and researching current market trends, to maintain your credibility as a trusted advisor.
- Building relationships with onshore teams and demonstrating your technical expertise and sector/ industry specific knowledge.
- Supervising a motivated team of professionals, guaranteeing they have the skills, knowledge and opportunities to reach their full potential.
- Lead end to end tax compliance cycle of the engagement and essentially collaborate with teams across EY.
- Develop knowledge in a broad range of tax technical and transaction skills and play a role of an effective change agent where required.
- Should have experience managing budgets, people and projects
- Participate in marketplace activities to expand professional network and contribute to the growth of practice through learning programs, Innovation & Technology development. Skills and attributes for success
- Ability to work and plan effectively with minimal direction in ambiguous situations
- Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on building high functioning teams
- Able to articulate/position complex/critical challenges, issues, etc.
- The ability to prioritise when working on multiple complex projects
- Strong influencing skills, and the confidence to question existing processes To qualify for the role, you must have
- 8
- 13 years of experience working in UK Tax environment.
- A bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business or a related discipline.
- Could be a certified ATT, CTA, ACCA
- Strong tax technical knowledge of UK Corporate Tax
- A proven record of excellence in a professional services or tax organisation Ideally, you’ll also have
- Awareness of other taxes in the UK
- Ability to read, interpret and apply the tax legislation What we look for We are looking for experienced tax professionals with genuine interest in providing outstanding services to some of the world’s most influential people. What we offer EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
- Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
- Success as defined by you : We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
- Transformative leadership : We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
- Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. - Apply your technical knowledge to our engagements / clients in ways that produce strategic outcomes to some very complex issues.
- Anchor a book of business by delivering a high quality work product efficiently, with managing risk.
- Developing clear, intelligent plans and approaches to improve our engagement economics. Drive margin outcome through effective utilisation of self and team.
- Provide meaningful business insights to client and onshore teams.
- Identifying potential opportunities for clients and potential additional opportunities that can be serviced from GDS.
- Learning and researching current market trends, to maintain your credibility as a trusted advisor.
- Building relationships with onshore teams and demonstrating your technical expertise and sector/ industry specific knowledge.

- The ability to prioritise when working on multiple complex projects
- Strong influencing skills, and the confidence to question existing processes To qualify for the role, you must have
- 8
- 13 years of experience working in UK Tax environment.

Job title: Staff Job purpose This position is responsible for assisting the Record to Report (R2R) team with various accounting processes, including
- Journal Entry Processing
- Account Reconciliations
- Financial Reporting Support Responsibilities
- Support Record to Report (R2R) activities, including journal entry processing, account reconciliation, and financial reporting.

- Experience in Record to Report (R2R) processes, with expertise in at least one of the following areas:
- Journal entry processing
- Account reconciliations
- Financial reporting support
- Experience in process transition and adaptation to new systems or tools.
- Basic knowledge of accounting processes.
- Knowledge of accounting principles (IFRS, US GAAP) is an added advantage.
- Proficient in Microsoft Excel and other MS Office packages.
- Experience with ERP systems such as Microsoft D365 or SAP (or similar financial systems).
- Strong organizational skills, initiative, and commitment to quality work
- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
- Motivated self-starter with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
- Willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges. Qualifications & Experience

Requisition Id: 1727851 As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self. The opportunity : Senior Consultant-FS-Tech Consulting-CNS
- TC
- TECHNOLOGY STRATEGY & TRANSFORMATION
- Bangalore FS : Finance fuels our lives. Banking, Insurance and Wealth management, create the foundations for growth, prosperity and peace of mind. No other Industry touches so many people or shapes so many lives. Amid sweeping regulatory change, today’s financial services institutions are focusing on digital transformation, convergence and disruption from an array of nontraditional competitors — all while meeting greater demands for trust and transparency. To address this delicate balance of issues, our competent team of business strategists, technologists and industry leaders bring fresh thinking and sector knowledge across banking and capital markets, insurance, and wealth and asset management. The results are seamless collaboration, innovative problem solving, breakthrough performance gains and sustainable value creation. We recruit, train and nurture a diverse set of people who dedicate their minds to building the future of financial services. Together, we explore new perspectives with innovative and entrepreneurial thinking to deliver exceptional client service and ensure that what we do today, counts for tomorrow. CNS
- TC
- TECHNOLOGY STRATEGY & TRANSFORMATION : EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services. In Tech Consulting, we are transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. It places humans@center, leverages technology@speed and enables innovation@scale. Your key responsibilities Technical Excellence
- Strong technical consulting experience in technology strategy and transformation engagements within financial services environments. Hands-on expertise in Java-based application development and modern software engineering practices. Working knowledge of AI solutions and their application in business and technology transformation initiatives. Exposure to GCP cloud services, scalable architecture, and cloud-native solution design. Familiarity with React and Dev Ops practices to support full-stack development and continuous delivery. Skills and attributes To qualify for the role you must have Qualification
- Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science Experience
- Software Architecture (6+ years) What we look for People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. title: Storyteller and Experience Manager - Assistant Director
jobDescription:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. Role name and description Client Experience Manager and Storyteller The Experience Centre Storyteller is the face and voice of the Client Experience Centre (CEC). This role is responsible for designing, curating, and delivering engaging client experiences that tell compelling stories about our capabilities, solutions, sector expertise, and vision for the future. The storyteller/host will work closely with sector leaders, solution owners, and creative teams to ensure every client visit is impactful, tailored, and memorable. Ultimately driving relationship growth and trust of new business opportunities. Your key responsibilities
- Client Hosting & Storytelling
- Welcome and host clients, partners, and internal stakeholders with professionalism and warmth.
- Deliver customized storytelling sessions aligned with client needs, sector priorities, and EY value propositions.
- Guide visitors through various Experience Centre zones (AI, Green Journey, Mega Trends, Four Futures, Sector Solutions, etc.) with engaging narratives.
- Adapt presentation style and content dynamically based on audience profile and engagement cues.
- Experience Design & Curation
- Collaborate with Experience Centre Manager and sector leaders to design client visit agendas.
- Incorporate relevant case studies, demos, and data points into stories.
- Ensure thematic continuity and emotional connection throughout the visitor journey.
- Integrate EY brand voice, tone, and messaging into every interaction.
- Coordination & Preparation
- Liaise with account/sector teams to understand client objectives before visits.
- Coordinate with technical, creative, and operations teams to ensure all zones and demos are ready.
- Review and rehearse storytelling flow before each client session.
- Content & Knowledge Management
- Maintain updated knowledge of EY offerings, sector trends, and market developments.
- Update scripts, decks, and storytelling assets regularly.
- Curate success stories, client impact narratives, and innovation showcases.
- Feedback & Continuous Improvement
- Capture and analyse visitor feedback for quality improvement.
- Share insights with leadership and account teams to strengthen client relationships.
- Suggest creative enhancements for zones, demos, and narratives. To qualify for the role, you must have
- Core Competencies
- Exceptional storytelling and public speaking skills.
- Strong presence, confidence, and stage management.
- Ability to simplify complex technical or sectoral concepts into relatable narratives.
- Client-centric mindset with high emotional intelligence.
- Strong coordination and time management skills.
- Proficiency in English (Must) Technical & Business Skills
- Familiarity with new technology solutions, and sector trends.
- Knowledge of EY service lines and industry offerings (can be learned on job).
- Comfort using AV/interactive display technologies. Behavioural Skills
- Warm, engaging personality with natural rapport-building ability.
- Adaptable and quick-thinking under changing circumstances.
- Collaborative and proactive in a team environment. Ideally, you will also be –
- Onsite presence required during client visits.
- Flexible to work extended hours for special events or international client visits.
- Travel may be required to support Experience Centre activations in other locations. What we look for
- Bachelor’s/master’s degree in communications, Marketing, Business, or related field.
- 8–12 years of experience in client-facing, presales, or event hosting roles.
- Experience in consulting, corporate communications, media, or hospitality preferred.
- Proven experience in delivering presentations or moderating high-profile sessions. What we offer EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across nine locations – Argentina, India, the Philippines, Sri Lanka, Poland, Spain, Hungary and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
- Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
- Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
- Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
- Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. EY | Building a better working world EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today. Role name and description Client Experience Manager and Storyteller The Experience Centre Storyteller is the face and voice of the Client Experience Centre (CEC). This role is responsible for designing, curating, and delivering engaging client experiences that tell compelling stories about our capabilities, solutions, sector expertise, and vision for the future. Ultimately driving relationship growth and trust of new business opportunities. Your key responsibilities

- Welcome and host clients, partners, and internal stakeholders with professionalism and warmth.

title: GDS Alliances Operations Lead Analyst - ServiceNow Alliance - Supervising Associate
jobDescription:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. Job Title: GDS Alliance Operations Lead Analyst Job Summary: The GDS Alliance Operations Lead Analyst will operate from the GDS Alliances Delivery Center and provide structured operations, governance, stakeholder coordination, reporting, content management and execution support for the Service Now Alliance within the broader Global Alliances and Ecosystem Relationship Enablement function. The role will help alliance leadership run an effective, insight-led and scalable operating model by tracking priorities, managing operational cadence, improving process discipline and enabling timely execution of Service Now alliance initiatives across sell, build and deliver motions. The incumbent will work closely with alliance, market, finance, contracts, training, BMC and enablement stakeholders to strengthen delivery consistency, improve data and reporting quality, simplify ways of working and identify automation opportunities, including the responsible use of AI-enabled tools to reduce manual effort, enhance reporting narratives and improve operational outcomes. Essential Functions of the Job:
- Serve as the central operations and PMO support point for assigned alliance activities, ensuring priorities, workstreams, owners, timelines, risks, dependencies and follow-ups are clearly captured, tracked and progressed with discipline.
- Provide Service Now alliance leadership with timely business insights through structured reporting, dashboards and executive-ready narratives covering sales, pipeline, opportunity tagging, partner-sourced and co-sell activity, prospect tracking, key GTM wins, book of business movements, partner program measures and other performance indicators.
- Support governance cadence for leadership meetings, QBRs, planning forums and operational reviews by developing agendas, storyboarding content, coordinating inputs, preparing meeting materials, capturing actions and tracking closure.
- Maintain and continuously refresh alliance reference materials, Share Point content, leadership-ready presentations, internal updates and other enablement assets to improve findability, consistency, relevance and adoption across stakeholder groups.
- Coordinate with Brand, Marketing and Communications teams to develop, review and maintain alliance-related content, ensuring alignment with messaging standards, stakeholder expectations and partner program requirements.
- Program manage Service Now partner tools, portals and operational processes, including partner portal access request tracking, issue resolution, adoption monitoring, certification and skills currency tracking, training coordination and tool administration support.
- Work with alliance investment, finance, legal and enablement teams to support Service Now Market Development Fund processes, investment tracking, compliance monitoring, quarterly reviews, documentation readiness, claims support and process adherence.
- Support Service Now alliance contract and governance activities, including initiation and tracking of localization of global agreements, program documentation, partner distinction or specialization requirements and related compliance actions in collaboration with the Ecosystem Contracts team and relevant business stakeholders.
- Partner with onshore Service Now alliance enablement contacts on strategic projects, transformation initiatives, stakeholder mapping, partner offering or marketplace coordination, event or sponsorship coordination, training interventions and other priority initiatives as required.
- Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and improve alliance operations processes through process mapping, documentation, issue analysis, control strengthening, data quality improvement and adoption of reusable templates and playbooks.
- Leverage automation and responsible AI-enabled tools, where appropriate, to reduce repetitive manual activity, improve reporting turnaround time, support content drafting, enhance insight generation, improve follow-up tracking and enable scalable service delivery.
- Manage stakeholder expectations, communication plans and delivery commitments with clarity, responsiveness and strong service orientation across global and regional teams. Knowledge and Skill Requirements:
- Strong understanding of alliance, ecosystem or partner program operations, preferably in a professional services, technology, consulting, shared services, GCC or global capability center environment; exposure to Service Now, enterprise software, workflow automation, low-code platforms or digital transformation ecosystems would be advantageous.
- Working knowledge of sales, revenue, pipeline, opportunity lifecycle, partner program metrics, GTM motions, co-sell or referral activity, partner distinctions, specialization requirements and performance reporting, with the ability to interpret data and convert it into concise executive-ready insights.
- Strong program and project management skills, including planning, tracking, governance cadence management, risk and dependency monitoring, action follow-up and management of multiple priorities with competing deadlines.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Power Point, with Power BI, Power Automate, Share Point, workflow tools or other reporting and collaboration platforms considered an advantage.
- Experience with continuous improvement, process simplification and operational excellence, including process mapping, SOP development, control documentation, audit readiness, root cause analysis and issue resolution.
- Ability to identify automation opportunities and apply digital tools responsibly to improve productivity, reporting quality, follow-up discipline, knowledge management and stakeholder experience.
- Practical exposure to generative AI tools for research, content development, summarization, insight generation, workflow support and productivity enhancement; preferable exposure to Agentic AI concepts, AI-enabled process automation, AI agents or Copilot-style productivity tools.
- Strong stakeholder management capability, with the ability to engage senior onshore stakeholders, anticipate needs, manage expectations and build trusted advisor relationships across functions and geographies.
- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including business writing, executive presentation development, narrative building and the ability to create high-quality content with limited initial guidance.
- Strong analytical thinking, problem solving, research capability and attention to detail, with the ability to work across multiple teams to drive practical and timely resolution.
- Experience working in virtual, matrixed and multi-geography environments with cultural sensitivity, collaboration discipline and a global mindset.
- Knowledge of EY and GDS operations, organization structure, operating model, management information systems and independence concepts for internal candidates; Big 4, consulting, technology or leadership support exposure for external candidates would be preferred. Job Requirements: Academics:
- MBA, postgraduate qualification, or equivalent professional experience preferred.
- Bachelor’s degree required; degree in business, technology, engineering, commerce, or a related discipline preferred.
- Project/program management certification, process improvement certification, or relevant alliance, partner program, Service Now, technology partner or enterprise software certification would be an added advantage.
- Relevant certifications or digital badges in generative AI, responsible AI, AI-enabled productivity, prompt engineering, automation, analytics, or Agentic AI concepts would be highly desirable, particularly where they demonstrate practical application in business operations, reporting, process improvement, knowledge management, or stakeholder enablement. Experience:
- 8+ years of progressive, relevant experience in alliance operations, program management, business operations, sales/GTM enablement, ecosystem support, consulting operations, technology partner enablement or enterprise software partner operations; exposure to Service Now or comparable software alliance environments would be preferred.
- Demonstrated experience supporting senior stakeholders in a matrixed, global environment, with exposure to governance routines, executive reporting, process coordination, and cross-functional delivery.
- Experience in reporting, dashboarding, content development, stakeholder tracking, or operational improvement initiatives would be beneficial. - Strong relationship building / collaboration skills (as our captive client base is a good source of referral work)

title: Organizational Change Management - Senior Manager
jobDescription:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. EY- Global Delivery Services (GDS) – Consulting – People Consulting (PC)
- Change Management – Senior Manager About Global Delivery Services Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda. Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom. Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service. Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services. Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation. The Opportunity We are looking for Senior Managers with expertise in Change Management to join the PC team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading global professional services organisation whilst being instrumental in growth of the PC team. Your Key Responsibilities
- Lead change management capability within the practice, grow and lead a team of change and learning design specialists
- Liaison with regional member firms selling work in the change management and learning space to build project pipeline
- Identify and build new capabilities in the team based on trends in the various market regions
- Enable delivery and execution of change management strategy for global large transformation programs in partnership with global EY offices.
- Provide advice and guidance as a subject matter expert and work effectively as part of a large, distributed program team.
- Ensure high quality deliverables are produced for the project by exhaustive internal reviews and obtain excellent feedback from the client and global project counterparts
- Manage engagement risk, project economics, manage escalations and ensure effective planning and budgeting
- Perform the role of a counsellor and coach, define and set goals, conduct performance reviews and ensure ongoing learning and development of the team Skills and attributes for success
- High integrity and commitment to work in a new and challenging environment
- Ability to manage ambiguity and be proactive
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Cross cultural awareness and sensitivity
- High energy levels, agility and adaptability
- Open to travel nationally and internationally for client projects that are approved as per EY and country specific travel advisory guidelines Ideally, you’ll also have
- APMG, PROSCI® or equivalent certification
- Experience in creating project budget and resource estimates for several domains within HR and technology transformations
- Experience facilitating solution workshops and design sessions across multiple industry verticals and geographies
- Experience in identifying and deploying leading edge and impactful change communication strategies through an understanding of the client’s challenges and opportunities
- Experience in creating and empowering a network of Change practitioners to work in a cross functional and client-facing environment
- Expertise in recommending and leveraging new age/digital solutions to enable change such as automation, gamification, advanced analytics/visualization, day-in-life-of workshops
- Experience in identifying and leveraging data-driven change management techniques to drive the transformation
- Knowledge of one or more HCM cloud – Oracle, SAP, and other out-of-box HR technologies
- Working knowledge of Project management What we look for
- Postgraduate degree or equivalent with a specialization in Human Resources (India or abroad)
- 17 -19 years of relevant experience
- Hands on experience in executing large and complex organizational change or transformation projects
- Wide range of HR Transformation, Digital Strategy and ERP Transformation expertise and cross-industry experience, with depth of exposure to at least one or more sectors
- Experience in advising and guiding clients on complex transformation programs with key domain expertise in business readiness, business adoption, change strategy, visioning, execution, stakeholder management, benefits management, and communication
- Experience in managing large and distributed teams and the ability to future-proof the workforce through upskilling and reskilling interventions
- Experience in learning design and content development using techniques of instructional design and application of it to enable a change program
- Experience in selling and delivering work that spans across the full project lifecycle What we offer you At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
- Our Commitment : As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
- Professional Development : From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
- People and Culture : In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
- Benefits : Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
- How to Apply : If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today. jobDescription:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. Associate 66.2– CRM Operations At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. The opportunity This opportunity is in the global operations teams of EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) which is rapidly growing. As our efforts towards building a better working world, GDS operations need to create an evolving framework of CRM Operational excellence framework control in all processes, decision making and activities for GDS operations to enable our business teams across locations. As an Associate Risk Management Analyst, you will take on a more advanced role in supporting the risk management department. Building on the foundational skills developed at the Associate level, you will have increased responsibilities in managing risk management tools, performing more complex tasks related to client and engagement acceptance, and contributing to the continuous improvement of risk management processes. You will also mentor junior team members and provide more in-depth analysis and reporting. Your key responsibilities
- Manage more complex aspects of risk management tools, including advanced troubleshooting and problem resolution.
- Lead the implementation of new features or updates in risk management systems, including coordinating with IT and other relevant teams.
- Ensure data integrity within risk management tools, performing regular audits and making necessary corrections.
- Conduct detailed reviews of client and engagement documentation, identifying and assessing potential risks.
- Assist in developing and refining processes for client and engagement acceptance to improve efficiency and compliance.
- Liaise with the onshore team and other departments to resolve any issues related to client and engagement acceptance.
- Prepare and analyze complex reports on risk management activities, identifying trends and areas for improvement.
- Support the development of compliance frameworks and contribute to internal audits by providing necessary documentation and insights.
- Act as a point of contact for more complex queries and issues, both from within the team and from other departments.
- Contribute to the ongoing improvement of risk management processes, identifying areas for efficiency gains or risk reduction.
- Participate in cross-functional projects aimed at enhancing overall risk management capabilities within the organization.
- Stay current with industry trends, best practices, and regulatory changes, and share relevant insights with the team. Qualification, Skills, and attributes for success
- Bachelor’s degree in finance, business, risk management, or a related field.
- 1-3 years of experience in risk management, finance, or a related area.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel.
- Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
- Experience with risk management tools and systems is highly desirable.
- Excellent communication and leadership skills.
- This is a hybrid role. What we look for
- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
- Proactive approach to identifying and solving problems.
- Strong mentoring and leadership capabilities. What we offer EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
- Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
- Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
- Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
- Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. jobDescription:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. Job Title : GDS Emerging Tech Relationships Operations Manager Function : GDS ES Growth & Innovation Skill Level: High Sub Function: Alliances Partner Ops Co E Role Purpose The Emerging Tech Relationships Operations Manager (Assistant Director) exists to enable alliance and ecosystem initiatives through disciplined operational execution and coordination. The role ensures that research activities, program workflows, reporting, and content outputs are well‑structured, accurately tracked, and consistently delivered, allowing senior leaders and strategists to focus on decision‑making and direction. Acting as an operational anchor across teams and systems, the role drives follow‑through, data integrity, and execution reliability across emerging relationship priorities. Role Summary The Emerging Tech Relationships Operations Manager provides hands‑on operational, PMO, and coordination support for alliance and ecosystem programs. Working closely with senior team members, the role translates clearly defined requirements into organized research outputs, structured materials, accurate trackers, and timely reports. Responsibilities span market and company research support, content preparation, program coordination, CRM and system maintenance, and performance tracking, with a strong emphasis on precision, responsiveness, and execution quality. The role is execution‑focused, prioritizing structure, consistency, and delivery across multiple workstreams. Success in this position is defined by the ability to manage details, maintain momentum, and ensure that data, materials, and reporting are ready for leadership consumption, while coordinating effectively across functions. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Market Research & Support (Execution‑Focused)
- Execute defined market and company research tasks based on clear requirements provided by senior team members.
- Support market scans through:
- Web‑based research
- Use of AI tools to compile and structure company lists
- Data extraction and organization from Pitch Book or similar platforms (where applicable).
- Assist with initial screening activities, including basic company information, leadership identification, and high‑level fit indicators.
- Maintain well‑organized records of research inputs and outputs to ensure traceability and re-use. Content Development & Packaging
- Prepare structured, digestible outputs (slides, summaries, trackers, briefing materials) based on existing analysis and guidance.
- Support the development, standardization, and maintenance of templates, decks, and written content used across ecosystem initiatives.
- Ensure all materials are accurate, clearly structured, and review‑ready for senior stakeholders. Program & PMO Support
- Provide PMO‑style operational support for alliance and ecosystem initiatives, including:
- Maintaining plans, trackers, timelines, and work logs
- Coordinating inputs across multiple teams
- Supporting meeting preparation and follow‑ups.
- Assist with planning and logistics for ecosystem activities such as VC interactions or market visits.
- Ensure execution remains aligned to agreed timelines and priorities through consistent follow‑through. Relationship & System Management
- Maintain and update company and relationship records across CRM and internal tracking tools.
- Support ongoing monitoring of priority companies and initiatives to ensure continuity and visibility.
- Ensure data hygiene, consistency, and accuracy across systems such as CRM, BRIDGE, GIS, and ERIP trackers. Reporting & Performance Tracking
- Support performance tracking and reporting at:
- ERIP level
- Program and function level.
- Compile data, maintain dashboards or trackers, and prepare summary reports for leadership review.
- Ensure reporting outputs are timely, consistent, and aligned with governance expectations. Cross‑Team Coordination
- Work closely with Risk Management Services and other internal teams to support BRIDGE‑related operational activities.
- Engage with business teams primarily to gather inputs, clarify requirements, and coordinate execution, escalating issues where required.
- Serve as a paired or backup resource with similar roles to ensure continuity and coverage across time zones. General Operational Support
- Support additional operational and administrative tasks as assigned to ensure smooth functioning of ecosystem activities.
- Contribute to maintaining execution discipline, structure, and reliability across all assigned workstreams. Knowledge Requirements:
- Alliance & Ecosystem Operations Context
- Working understanding of alliance and ecosystem programs, particularly how operational support enables research, tracking, and program execution.
- Awareness of early‑stage company discovery and screening concepts, without requiring deep strategic or commercial evaluation expertise.
- Understanding of how ecosystem initiatives are supported through structured research, coordination, and reporting, rather than strategy formulation. Market & Company Research Fundamentals
- Knowledge of basic market and company research techniques, including:
- Web‑based research
- Company profile compilation
- High‑level fit and leadership identification
- Familiarity with market intelligence platforms such as Pitch Book (or similar), sufficient to extract and organize data.
- Awareness of how AI tools can be used to support company discovery and list building (practical usage, not advanced analytics). Program & PMO Concepts
- Understanding of PMO‑style execution, including:
- Workplan and timeline tracking
- Dependency management
- Meeting coordination and follow‑ups
- Knowledge of how programs like ERIP are tracked and supported operationally. Systems & Data Management
- Familiarity with CRM systems and internal enterprise tools used for tracking companies, relationships, and initiatives.
- Understanding of data hygiene principles, including accuracy, consistency, and traceability across multiple systems (eg. CRM, BRIDGE, GIS, ERIP trackers). Skill Requirements:
- Operational Execution & Follow‑Through
- Strong ability to execute clearly defined workstreams with minimal supervision and low rework.
- High attention to detail and consistency in delivering outputs.
- Ability to maintain momentum across multiple parallel tasks. Organization & Coordination
- Excellent organizational and tracking skills, with comfort managing:
- Task lists
- Trackers and dashboards
- Timelines and dependencies
- Ability to coordinate inputs across teams and ensure timely follow‑ups.
- Comfortable operating as a paired or backup resource to ensure continuity and coverage.
- Reliable, responsive, and disciplined in meeting deadlines.
- Strong service mindset with a focus on execution quality and reliability. Business Communication
- Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to translate instructions and inputs into clean, structured outputs.
- Comfortable interacting with business teams to gather inputs, clarify requirements, and escalate issues when necessary. Content Preparation & Presentation Skills
- Strong ability to produce well‑structured presentations, summaries, trackers, and documents.
- Attention to formatting, clarity, and accuracy to ensure materials are review‑ready for senior stakeholders.
- Comfort working with standard templates and maintaining content consistency. Reporting & Performance Tracking
- Ability to compile data, maintain trackers or dashboards, and support performance reporting at:
- ERIP level
- Program and function level
- Skill in preparing summary reports that are accurate, timely, and aligned with governance expectations. Other Guidance: Academics & Experience

Relationship & System Management Maintain and update company and relationship records across CRM and internal tracking tools. Support ongoing monitoring of priority companies and initiatives to ensure continuity and visibility. Ensure data hygiene, consistency, and accuracy across systems such as CRM, BRIDGE, GIS, and ERIP trackers. Reporting & Performance Tracking Support performance tracking and reporting at: ERIP level Program and function level. Compile data, maintain dashboards or trackers, and prepare summary reports for leadership review. Ensure reporting outputs are timely, consistent, and aligned with governance expectations. Engage with business teams primarily to gather inputs, clarify requirements, and coordinate execution, escalating issues where required. - Learns and understands key requirements of firm, structure, business strategies and different regulatory RMS rules and policies

title: GDS Next Frontier - Quantum Senior Associate - India
jobDescription:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. Discipline: GDS Enablement Services – Growth & Innovation Role title: Quantum – Senior Associate Position Summary: The Quantum Senior Associate will play a hands-on delivery role across Quantum Technology initiatives, with stronger ownership for solution design, technical execution, stakeholder communication and delivery quality than an Associate role. The role requires practical experience in quantum-safe security and/or quantum computing, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business and delivery outcomes. The role is expected to have a primary focus on quantum safety, including post-quantum cryptography readiness, and a secondary focus on quantum computing use cases such as optimization, machine learning and simulation. Key responsibilities
- Support the development of quantum safety and quantum computing solutions, prototypes and demonstrations.
- Contribute to post-quantum cryptography readiness assessments, including data gathering, analysis and documentation.
- Develop and evaluate quantum algorithms and workflows for selected optimization, machine learning and simulation use cases.
- Build and maintain software tools, accelerators and proof-of-concept assets using established engineering practices.
- Prepare technical documentation, assessment reports and presentation materials for internal and external stakeholders.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including cybersecurity, AI/ML, platform engineering and product teams.
- Participate in testing, validation and benchmarking activities to assess solution performance and applicability.
- Stay current on developments in quantum computing, post-quantum cryptography and related emerging technologies. Quantum Specialist

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Quantum Cyber / Safety:
- Support quantum risk assessments and identify areas that may require future cryptographic modernization.
- Assist in prototyping and benchmarking post-quantum cryptography algorithms within applications and services.
- Contribute to analysis of quantum-safe and hybrid cryptographic approaches and document findings.
- Support development of crypto-inventory and discovery capabilities to identify legacy cryptography dependencies.
- Execute testing of hybrid key exchange mechanisms and document performance observations.
- Assist with implementation and validation of crypto-agility patterns, certificate updates and key management enhancements.
- Contribute to creation and maintenance of migration guides, standards documentation and operational runbooks.
- Quantum Compute & Algorithms:
- Develop and evaluate quantum algorithms using industry-standard quantum development platforms.
- Support experimentation and testing to assess the practicality of quantum use cases.
- Build proof-of-concept solutions for optimization, simulation and emerging Quantum + AI use cases.
- Perform basic resource estimation and analysis of quantum circuits and algorithm performance.
- Compare classical and quantum approaches and document observations and recommendations.
- Maintain reproducible experimentation environments using Python, Jupyter notebooks, containers and source control tools.
- Knowledge and Skills Requirements:
- Foundational understanding of quantum computing concepts, including qubits, gates, quantum circuits and current hardware limitations.
- •Basic understanding of post-quantum cryptography concepts, key encapsulation mechanisms, digital signatures and emerging standards.
- Familiarity with cryptographic concepts such as public-key cryptography, certificates and secure communication protocols.
- Experience with at least one quantum development platform such as Qiskit, Penny Lane, Cirq, Azure Quantum or AWS Braket.
- Proficiency in Python programming and familiarity with commonly used scientific and data analysis libraries.
- Working knowledge of software development fundamentals, including version control and testing practices.
- Ability to design and execute experiments, analyse results and communicate findings effectively.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
- Effective written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to work collaboratively in global, cross-functional teams.
- Interest in emerging technologies and willingness to continuously learn new concepts and tools. Education and Experience:
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Cybersecurity, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
- 2–5+ years of relevant experience in one or more of the following areas:
- Software development or engineering
- Applied cryptography or cybersecurity
- Data science, machine learning or advanced analytics
- Quantum computing research or development
- High-performance or scientific computing
- Experience developing prototypes, proof-of-concepts or technical solutions using modern programming languages and frameworks.
- Familiarity with Python and scientific computing libraries such as Num Py, Sci Py, pandas or similar tools.
- Exposure to quantum computing concepts, quantum software development kits or post-quantum cryptography is preferred but not mandatory.
- Understanding of cybersecurity and cryptography fundamentals is desirable.
- Experience working in agile, research or innovation-focused environments is advantageous.
- Ability to independently complete assigned deliverables while collaborating effectively with senior team members.
- Publications, hackathons, certifications, research projects or open-source contributions related to quantum technologies are beneficial but not required.
- Willingness to work with global teams and support overlap with US East Coast hours when needed. title: Security Analyst
jobDescription:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. Information Security Analyst – Associate/Senior Associate Today’s world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 950 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets! Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team helps protect the EY brand and build client trust. Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value. The opportunity The Technology Assurance, Risk, and Policy (TARP) function within Information Security strives to create and promote a holistic Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) program by creating a robust, resilient, and proactive governance framework, supported by a strategic risk management approach and stringent compliance structures. It aims to integrate and align its GRC initiatives in line with the global firm's objectives and emerging threats within the cybersecurity landscape. The Technology Assurance team develops provides security assurance on EY’s deployed technology to internal and external stakeholders. The team members act as subject matter experts across a number of information and cyber security disciplines that include, among others, application and network penetrating testing and vulnerabilities identification, information security audits, compliance to cyber security and regulatory frameworks, and conducting or coordinating security audits and assessments. All applications must pass through security review prior to EY production usage. Security Certification checks the compliance of the application against EY security standards. The team develops the overall strategy and for implementing various technical attack and penetration assessment, information security audits like HITRUST, SOC 1 and SOC 2 to provide third-party assurance to EY’s Clients in EY’s senior leadership. The team is responsible of overseeing and leading the technical audit process that includes third-party external assessments of client-facing critical business applications, M365 Teams Apps, Network, cloud configuration reviews, infrastructure reviews, UK Cyber Essentials Plus Certification and UK IT Health Check Certification. The team manages Attack and Penetration testing controls based on Industry Standards and obtain third-party security attestations/certifications to enable EY Business to win in the market. The team also manages and maintains the firm’s ISO 27001 certifications is responsible for the end-end delivery of attestation audits like SOC 1 and SOC2. Technical compliance to regulatory framework like Internation Standard on Quality Management (ISQM) is also a responsibility of the team. An Information Security Analyst will work closely with team leads to assist with one of the security functional areas described above. Your key responsibilities
- Preparing detailed security review reports and remediation guidance
- Researching new application security vulnerabilities and attack vectors
- Support the team in updating their skill and knowledge
- Leading strategic initiatives and mentoring new team members
- Continuous improvement to improve quality of service
- Configure, manage, and update vulnerability assessment tools to ensure they are running optimally and providing accurate results Skills and attributes for success
- Hands on experience of Web, thick client, Mobile, VOIP, Wireless application security testing
- Proficient in automated and manual application testing methodologies
- Expert in using manual testing tools such as Burp Professional, Nmap, Wireshark, Nessus, echomirage
- Expert in using automated application scan tool Webinspect / Qualys WAS, Check Marx, White Source etc..
- Basic Knowledge of programming language like C/C++, C#, JAVA, ASP.NET and familiar with PERL/Python Scripting
- Basic understanding of secure coding principles and common coding vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top Ten). This helps in identifying vulnerabilities during code reviews and collaborating with development team
- Knowledge of common security requirements within ASP.NET & Java application
- Good knowledge of TCP/IP, Network Security
- Hands-on experience in testing AI integrated projects
- Capable of testing both Android & i OS based applications
- Knowledge to perform manual code review
- Good Technical aptitude, problem solving and ability to quickly learn and master new topics and domains
- Excellent communication skills; written and verbal To qualify for the role you must have
- 1 to 6 years of experience in application security assessment
- Hands on experience of Web, thick client, Mobile Application security reviews
- Exposure and good understanding of the various manual testing methodologies
- Knowledge of how vulnerabilities can lead to incidents and the role of vulnerability assessments in incident detection and response
- A grasp of how applications, networks, and systems are architected from a security perspective. This includes understanding security controls like firewalls, IDS/IPS, and encryption
- Must be a strong multi-tasker and be able to prioritize duties Ideally, you’ll also have
- Bachelors or above in Information Technology or Cyber Security related Degrees
- Keen interest in pursuing relevant Information Security Certifications like CEH, OSCP CISSP, CISM, CISA, etc. What we offer As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:
- Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
- Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
- Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
- Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. EY | Building a better working world EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
